scenario.summary: Guest searches the grouped product, sets quantity 1, types the personalization text, ticks three checkbox add-ons, adds it to the cart and opens the cart; head of the class chain.
steps: Search the product by name and SKU and open it
Type the personalization text into the DisplayText field
Tick the three checkbox add-ons by name
Add to Cart and open the cart
stateChanges: Guest cart: the grouped product with personalization and three add-ons is added (removed by groupProductRemovedAllCartItems)
assertions: None in this method (the cart checks are in the dependsOn methods)
evidence: Method comment: Z10-TC-9013 search for the product and add to cart.

Class chain, first method captures (user decision 2026-11-04): groupProductSearchForTheProductAndAddToCart declares the need and every record value of the chain and keeps the record in class fields; the dependsOn methods read those fields and throw SkipException DATA_UNAVAILABLE when they are null. Consumers: groupProductVerifyGroupProductDetailsOnTheLineItem (name, child price, add-on prices), groupProductVerifyPersonalizeTextOnLineItem (config only), groupProductVerifyAddOnOptionsOnLineItem (composed line-item text).

Params: minAddOns 1 + addOnDisplayType CheckBox (selectAddOnOptionOfTypeCheckbox clicks the add-ons by name); minPersonalizableAttributes 1 + personalizationAttribute DisplayText (addTextToPersonalizeAttribute builds the input locator //input[@id='<label>'] from the label).

AddOnOption1..3 -> product.addOnName / addOn2Name / addOn3Name (the key's first three priced add-ons of CheckBox groups in display order); imported AddOnOptionPrice1..3 -> addOnPrice / addOn2Price / addOn3Price.
Gap (params): the test ticks three add-on products; minAddOns counts add-on groups, so a fallback product may have fewer than three (addOn3Name null).
PersonalizeLabel 'DisplayText' equals the pinned personalizationAttribute (config); PersonalizeText 'DisplaySampleText' is typed by the test (config); InitialQuantity '1' is config (quantityUsed).

Imported: GroupedProduct1Price '$22.48' -> product.child1SalesPrice (the grouped child whose quantity is set; shown price: sales, else child1RetailPrice). The line-item unit price is computed by the test (child price + three add-on prices).

Imported: AddOnOptions1 is composed '<child1Name>\nDisplayText : <typed text>\n<addOnGroupName> : <addOnName>' (one line per add-on; group label 'Checkbox' on the recorded product): data without output, built by the migrated test.

Read by the page object, not scanned: groupProductVerifyGroupProductDetailsOnTheLineItem reads includedProducts (getHashMap SCENARIO_TEST_DATA_NAME_GROUPED_PRODUCTS, keys GroupedProduct<n>) for verifyGroupIncludedProductList -> product.child1Name (only the child added). No source entries: the cells are not in the scan.
Search uses search.searchForProduct(name, sku): both are data of product.
Profile (Playwright observations): z-2200003 is an active GroupedProduct in PRODUCTION, inventory 250, requiredAddOnCount 0.

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware; centralizedLoginEnabled=no), the same store as the Playwright webstore entries. Guest flow, no sign-in.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) was not run for these Selenium tests (profiled false); product facts come from bin/tda rows (2026-11-06) and the approved Playwright pdp entries.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays) are framework constants: role config, no need.
